description:
This tool calls the Actor "industrial_platform/research-brief-agent" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Use for current cited multi-source research, comparisons, and fact verification. Returns a synthesized brief with citations. $1.99 per completed brief; failed runs are not billed.

This tool requires an x402 payment. Include a valid x402 payment signature in the request metadata (_meta["x402/payment"]). Your MCP client must support the x402 payment protocol.

inputSchema.description: Generate a current, source-backed research brief from a question, optional context, and custom requirements.

context.description: Optional decision context, constraints, audience, or background that should shape the research.
context.title: Context

requirements.description: Optional output and evidence requirements such as comparison criteria, source preferences, tables, calculations, citations, or unresolved-fact handling.
requirements.title: Additional requirements

research_question.description:
**REQUIRED** REQUIRED. The current multi-source research question to investigate. Use a specific question that needs web research, comparison, verification, citations, or synthesis.
Example values: "What are the current official Model Context Protocol transport options in the latest specification?"
examples: What are the current official Model Context Protocol transport options in the latest specification?
research_question.prefill: What are the current official Model Context Protocol transport options in the latest specification?
research_question.title: Research question

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

inputSchema.title: Research Brief Agent

name: industrial_platform--research-brief-agent

actorId.description: Stable Apify Actor ID from the run record

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the run; present only for Console sessions

exitCode.description: Actor process exit code; populated for terminal states (especially FAILED)

finishedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run finished (terminal states only)

nextStep.description: One primary follow-up action with identifiers interpolated

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run started

status.description: Run status: READY | RUNNING | TIMING-OUT | TIMED-OUT | ABORTING | ABORTED | SUCCEEDED | FAILED

storages.description: Dataset and key-value store metadata, keyed by alias. "default" is always the primary entry.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the dataset; present only for Console sessions

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

inflatedBytes.description: Approximate uncompressed byte size of the dataset. Use with itemCount to pick limit/fields before fetching.

datasets.description: Map of dataset alias → metadata. Key "default" is always the run's primary dataset.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the dataset; present only for Console sessions

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

inflatedBytes.description: Approximate uncompressed byte size of the dataset. Use with itemCount to pick limit/fields before fetching.

itemsSchema.description: JSON Schema for rows in the dataset at `storages.datasets.default.id` — describes row shape only; the rows themselves are NOT returned inline in this response. Inferred from this Actor's historical successful runs. To fetch actual rows, call `get-dataset-items` with the dataset id and a `fields` projection drawn from this schema.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the store; present only for Console sessions

keyCount.description: Total number of keys (omitted when truncated)

keyValueStores.description: Map of key-value store alias → metadata. Key "default" is always the run's primary store.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the store; present only for Console sessions

keyCount.description: Total number of keys (omitted when truncated)

summary.description: Past-tense summary of the run state

tip.description: Advisory guidance RAG Web Browser wrote to its key-value store under the reserved "TIP" key

level.description: Omitted when the Actor wrote an unrecognized level

message.description: Truncated to 300 characters, with a trailing ellipsis if the Actor's message was longer

recommendedActorId.description: Apify Actor ID the tip recommends running next, when it names one — pass directly as `actor` to call-actor or fetch-actor-details

title: industrial_platform/research-brief-agent
